product_lines.name: 10-Mil Heavy Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Professional-grade 10-mil poly for demanding applications. Reinforced corners for extra durability. Ideal for construction sites, debris covers, and outdoor storage.

product_lines.name: 12-Mil Extra Heavy Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Extra heavy duty 12-mil poly tarp with a 14x14 weave, sewn-in rope hems and reinforced corners. Used for roofing, scaffold enclosures and heavy-duty outdoor covers.

product_lines.name: 16-Mil Super Heavy Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Super heavy duty 16-mil poly tarp with a 16x16 weave and reinforced corners. Used by contractors and farms for longer-term outdoor covers and storage.

product_lines.name: 20-Mil Ultra Heavy Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Ultra heavy duty 20-mil poly tarp, the thickest poly we carry, with a 16x16 weave and reinforced corners. Used for semi-permanent covers and harsh-weather exposure.

product_lines.name: 5-Mil Light Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Lightweight poly tarp for temporary use. Great for camping, home projects, furniture covers, and general outdoor use.

product_lines.name: 7-Mil Standard Duty Poly
product_lines.description: Multi-purpose 7-mil poly tarp with a 10x10 weave and aluminum grommets. For indoor and outdoor use: equipment covers, truck beds and ground protection on job sites.

product_lines.name: 10 oz Cotton Canvas Tarp
product_lines.description: 10oz cotton canvas tarp. Water-resistant (not waterproof). Double stitched hem. Breathable — ideal for covering items that need air circulation. Perfect for machinery, vehicles, and materials that should not trap moisture.

product_lines.name: Heavy Cotton Canvas Tarp
product_lines.description: Traditional breathable cotton canvas. Used for painting drop cloths, vehicle covers, and applications where air circulation matters.

product_lines.name: Clear Vinyl Tarp (20 Mil)
product_lines.description: Heavy duty 20-mil clear PVC vinyl tarp with brass grommets. See-through, for enclosures, windbreaks and patios where visibility matters.

product_lines.name: Clear Vinyl Tarp (30 Mil)
product_lines.description: Super heavy duty 30-mil clear PVC vinyl tarp with brass grommets, the thickest clear vinyl we carry. For enclosures and longer-term installations.

product_lines.name: Fire Retardant Clear Vinyl Tarp
product_lines.description: Fire-retardant 20-mil clear PVC vinyl tarp for welding curtains and enclosures. Ask us for the supplier's fire-test certification before relying on it for a code requirement.

product_lines.name: Fire Retardant Poly Tarp
product_lines.description: Fire-retardant poly for welding areas, electrical work and other jobs that call for flame-resistant coverings. Ask us for the supplier's fire-test certification for your job file.

product_lines.name: Mesh Tarp
product_lines.description: Black polypropylene mesh tarp with double-stitched hems and grommets. About 60% shade while letting air through. Used for shade, privacy screens, debris containment, dump trucks and fence covers.
